chemical-bund-50l.shortDescription: 50L polyethylene chemical bund for secondary containment, sized to suit the 50L Chemical Dosing Tank.
chemical-bund-50l.description:
A **50L polyethylene chemical bund** designed to provide secondary containment for the matching 50L Chemical Dosing Tank.

The bund is sold separately so customers can add containment when required for their installation. Its moulded, tapered profile is designed to accept the matching tank while providing additional containment volume around it.

- 50L nominal bund size
- Approx. 480 mm top outside diameter
- Approx. 360 mm bottom outside diameter
- Approx. 425 mm overall height
- Rotationally moulded polyethylene construction
- Sized to suit the 50L Chemical Dosing Tank
features: Sized to suit the matching 50L Chemical Dosing Tank
recommendedFor: Secondary containment for the 50L Chemical Dosing Tank

compliance.note: Secondary-containment bund - WaterMark does not apply. Confirm site-specific containment requirements for the chemical, stored volume, installation and jurisdiction.
